mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which may lead to wage inflation and subsequently to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 5% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as companies may face reduced output and profitability.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2%, this indicates a potential monetary policy mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified conditions are met and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests strong labor market conditions, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified conditions are met and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which is a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases sharply and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 70% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) signals a contraction in economic activity, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies may face reduced demand and profitability.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances.
